name: Simulated Reality Weave
summary: The interleaved multi-view format used by Leia Inc. (Lume Pad tablets), Acer SpatialLabs, and SR (Super Retina / Dimenco) auto-stereoscopic displays. A weave interleaves multiple views at the subpixel level for the display's lenticular or barrier layer to separate into per-angle streams.

variants.name: Leia Weave (4-view)
variants.description: Standard 4-view weave for Leia Lume Pad and compatible displays.

variants.name: SR Display Weave
variants.description: Variant used by Acer SpatialLabs and Dimenco SR displays. Delivered via DisplayPort 1.4 with 3D Game Bridge routing.

hardware_requirements: Leia, Acer SpatialLabs, or compatible SR display
3D Game Bridge or LeiaPlayer for routing
pipeline_notes: Typically requires 3D Game Bridge to convert a standard SBS or stereo output into the display-specific weave format. Direct weave output from Geo-11 is possible on some setups with display SDK integration.
